### Must fix

**1. #36114's drawer pin goes red once both are on main.**
- On `main`, `RecordDetailView.commentsPanel-36075.test.tsx:286`, "no icon on a hand-written page, which keeps its own discussion block", mounts `{ pages: [AUTHORED_PAGE], embedded: true }`. It expects the authored discussion text, no comments button and no panel.
- With this PR the drawer takes the standard page (`assignedPage` is `null` off the desktop full page). The standard page is where `commentsPanelOffered` holds, so the icon appears and the comment leaves the body for the closed panel. All three expectations fail.
- A trial merge of `d386bd30` with `origin/main` is textually clean, so nothing flags this until CI runs on the merged head.
- Fix: merge `main`. Retarget that pin to the full page (drop `embedded`), where an authored page still keeps its discussion and shows no icon. Optionally add the drawer case as its opposite: an authored-page object's drawer offers the panel. Then re-run CI on the merged head.

**2. `Skills-docs:` is owed.**
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` rule 4 teaches `kind: 'full'` as "regions drawn as authored". Rule 5 sends a clicked row to the drawer.
- After this PR, an authored page is not drawn in that drawer or on a phone, and a `record_section` action is unreachable there unless it also declares `record_more`. An author following the skill would build exactly the page whose layout and section actions vanish in the default open mode.
- Fix: add that sentence to rule 4 (with the `record_more` advice and the two platform exceptions), and fill the `Skills-docs:` line in the body and the changeset. If you judge no skill change is needed, write `Skills-docs: none — <reason>` instead; the face needs the line either way.

### Read and fine

- **`authoredRecordPageApplies`** is the one reader:
  - a page named in the URL → applies;
  - `sys_approval_request` / `sys_user` → applies, as ruled;
  - otherwise only `!embedded && !phone`.
  
  `assignedPage` is the only thing it gates, and slotted pages (`assignedSlots`) are untouched. `usePhoneViewport` moves up once, and the old call site keeps its comment.
- **Embedded mounts:** every `<RecordDetailView embedded>` site (the list overlay, `ObjectDataPage`'s drawer, `InterfaceListPage`) is a drawer or preview, as the card means. No Studio page designer renders through it.
- **Showcase:**
  - `showcase_recalc_estimate` gains `record_more`.
  - The authored header's id list leaves it out, so the full page draws it once, in the section bar.
  - `record-action-location-hosts.test.ts` now pins three things: header set = record_header/record_more less section actions; no section action also inline in a header; every section action reachable under ⋯.
  - Shot `showcase_task-drawer-light-menu` shows ⋯ holding 重算工时.
- **The 17 test files:** only `embedded` → full page, each with a one-line note, and no assertion changed (sampled `feedGrant-12082`, `topInset-35745`).
  - Harness 32478's drawer case flips meaning on purpose. It now asserts the standard page and no explanation, which is the card's behaviour.
- **New pin** `authoredPageDesktopOnly-36150` (18 cases) covers the page, the phone, the drawer, ⋯, the CONTROL, and the slotted / ruled / named-page exceptions. 4 of the 18 go red with the reader forced `true`.
- **Evidence** in `build-seat1/36150/`: showcase project and task on page, drawer and phone (light and dark for the project), and HotCRM lead as the no-change control.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/app-shell` minor, user-facing, and it states the migration (`record_more`) and the exceptions.

Verdict: **REWORK** at `d386bd30`: items 1 and 2. The next head should have `main` merged; I'll do a delta read.

Scope: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordPageSurface.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.authoredPageDesktopOnly-36150.test.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx`, the seventeen `RecordDetailView.*.test.tsx` files that drop `embedded` (appendInset-27520, authoredActivityThreading-12249, commentWriteFailure-10899, discussionExplicitComposition-7298, discussionFallbackPipeline-8983, feedCommentEditDelete-12268, feedGrant-12082, feedLoading, feedRecordScope, oneProvenanceFooter-12307, reactionKeepIds-11019, reactionRecords-12078, reactionWriteFailure-10899, reactionsCommentRowsOnly-11035, replyCountOnRead-12144, topInset-35745, withheldMentions-28218), `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts`, `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/task-detail.page.ts`, `examples/app-showcase/test/record-action-location-hosts.test.ts` + read, not reviewed: `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` and `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` on `main`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/usePhoneViewport.ts`, `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/usePageAssignment.ts` (call site), `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md`. Not reviewed: the prose faces `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` and `.changeset/36150-authored-record-page-desktop-only.md`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set: unchanged, right. No file under `packages/spec` is in the diff; no key, value or refusal moves.
- Public surface of `@object-ui/app-shell`: unchanged in types and exports, right. `recordPageSurface.ts` is imported by `RecordDetailView.tsx` only and is not re-exported from `src/index.ts`. What moves is behaviour: the exported `RecordDetailView` mounted with `embedded`, or below 768 px, now sets `assignedPage` to `null` and takes the synthesized page, except for a page named in the URL and for `sys_approval_request` / `sys_user`.
- `authoredRecordPageApplies`: right against rulings 7066490078 and 7066506909 and against objectui#12715. `requestedPageName` is `undefined` whenever `embedded`, so the named-page arm is the full-page route's alone; a refused or pending named page is still held by `namedPageBlocked`, never replaced by the default page. `assignedSlots` is untouched, so a slotted page keeps its slots on every surface.
- The one other read of `resolvedPage` in the view (`recordPagePlacesNoComponent`) is guarded by `assignedPage`, so the drawer draws the standard page and no explanation; the changed harness pin is the right consequence.
- Showcase `showcase_recalc_estimate` gains `record_more`: right, ruling 7066506909 item 1. The authored header lists its ids and omits it, so the full page draws it once. The relaxed test invariant (no action both at `record_section` and inline at `record_header`) and the new one (every task `record_section` action also declares `record_more`) hold the example to that ruling; the package is private and publishes nothing.
- The seventeen harness moves change the mount, not an assertion; right as far as the diff shows.
- Wrong: the PR body's "everything downstream already keys off `assignedPage`, so nothing else changes". The reader UPSTREAM of the view does not: see M1.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no. Right: neither the accept set nor the export surface of a published package moves.
Metadata-protocol: semantic. Right: the meaning of an assigned `kind: 'full'` record page changes. By ruling A the kind alone sets the level, so `minor` on `@object-ui/app-shell`, the one published package the diff moves, is the right level. The changeset carries both lines and matches the PR body; `Check Changeset` is green on the head. The showcase is private and the docs page is not a package, so one entry is the whole set. The line carries no `(narrowing)` arm and needs none: nothing an author can write is refused.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag, type-check not run locally: answered by the head's check-runs. `Type Check UI`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Lint UI`, `Test UI` (all shards listed), `Build and E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Check Changeset`, `Spec property liveness` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` all conclude success; none failed.
- Dev flag, overlap with #36114 on the same view: a landing-order matter for the lane seat, no contract effect. Note for the seat: the head's merge base is `146b6f9b`, behind `main` at `8807dcb0`.
- Dev flag, a desktop window narrowed below 768 px also takes the standard page: accepted as the phone reading the card names, but it is the second way into M1.
- Dev flag, the harness case that changed meaning: answered in ①.
- `open_questions`: none open. F1 and F2 are closed by ruling 7066490078, F3, F4 and F6 by ruling 7066506909, F5 and F7 by merged rules; the follow-up for text-paired lists is filed (#36170, open).
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join; it changes which page schema is rendered.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing, read against the spec on `main`: the spec carries no refusal for a phone or a drawer. `PageSchema.isDefault` describes "the page the record view opens", `PageSchema.apps` names the route (`/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID` "opens this page"), `kind: 'full'` is "the schema fully describes the page", and the `slots.tabs` tombstone prescribes "a page that needs its own strip is `kind: 'full'`, drawn as authored". So this PR does not make a spec refusal real; it takes a declared capability away on two of three surfaces, at the consumer, on the maintainer's word (card, 2026-11-22 line, and the two rulings). The rulings settle the product; they do not settle where the contract is written, nor the defect below.

M1 (must-fix) — on the phone full page the standard page is synthesized from the wrong object list, so "one tab per child table" is not delivered. The record ROUTE's object scope (`appObjectScope.ts`, `declaredRecordPage` and the record-route arm that calls `readPageObjectScope`) still picks the object's declared full page on every surface and reads only the objects THAT PAGE binds, plus the route object, the app's required objects and lookup targets. Its own header states the premise this PR breaks: "the page it picks is the page `RecordDetailView` renders". `AppContent` hands that list to the view as `objects` (`allObjects`, the scope's objects unless a drawer joined the registry), and the view's `deriveRelatedLists(objectDef, objects, ...)` builds the standard page's child tabs from it. The scope has no phone reading. Result on a phone, or a desktop window under 768 px, at `/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID` for any object with an authored full page: the standard page shows only the child tables the authored page happened to bind; every other object pointing at the record is missing, although the same record in the desktop drawer (registry joined, objectstack#27626) shows them all. That contradicts card item 2 ("有哪些子表（每张一个页签）"), the acceptance line on tabs, ruling 7066506909 item 4 (organisation: three authored lists, about twenty more as tabs), and the sentence this PR adds to the docs and the changeset. Nothing in the diff covers it: the new test mounts `RecordDetailView` with `objects` passed directly, and the browser evidence (showcase project) cannot tell the two readings apart, since that authored page binds the tabs the phone showed. Fix shape: the route scope reads the same answer as the view (`authoredRecordPageApplies` over the same surface inputs, the two kept objects and the named page included), so a phone record route takes the synthesized-page arm (`readObjectsReferencing` or the registry), and follows the width when it crosses 768; pinned through `AppContent`, not only the view.

S1 (should-fix) — the published contract still says the opposite, and the narrowing is written only in the consumer and one docs page. The PR declares `Metadata-protocol: semantic` for a spec key whose spec text it leaves untouched. After it, on `main`'s spec: the `isDefault` describe, the `apps` describe (it names the exact URL that on a phone no longer opens the page) and the `slots.tabs` remedy send an author to `kind: 'full'` with no word that a list click, whose default is the drawer, will not draw it. The published skill `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` steps 4 and 5 teach the same ("`regions` drawn as authored"; "the drawer, which expands to the full page"). These are form help in Studio and the generated reference. A capability the spec declares is implemented or retired in the spec, never narrowed at the consumer alone: the describes of `kind`, `isDefault` and `apps`, the tombstone remedy and the skill should state the surface rule and the `record_more` remedy, with the generated artifacts. That is a `packages/spec` and governed-skill touch, so it carries its own schema or rules face; in this PR or in a companion that lands with it.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract; code nits are left as accepted deviations or a follow-up, since a fix moves the head):
- N1: `recordPageSurface.ts`, the `OBJECTS_KEEPING_AUTHORED_PAGE` jsdoc still reads "the seat's reading ... recommended option of the maintainer's decision card, built until the answer". The answer landed (7066490078); the comment should cite the ruling.
- N2: the exception is keyed on the object name, so ANY assigned full page of `sys_user` or `sys_approval_request`, an app-scoped one included, is kept everywhere. That is the ruling's wording ("the user page"); worth one line in the jsdoc.
- N3: `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` (prose face) does not say that a desktop window narrower than 768 px counts as the phone, nor name an interface page's preview among the embedded views; the changeset does the second.
- N4: nothing pins that printing a default print page from the desktop full page keeps the authored page. It holds today only because `usePhoneViewport` re-reads `window.innerWidth` rather than the media query; a pin belongs with the M1 fix.
- N5: the retitled case in `record-action-location-hosts.test.ts` ("... but the section bar's") reads as a fragment.

Tried and held: named page on a phone (drawn, or refused with no fallback); slotted page on all three surfaces; drawer of an object whose full page places no component (standard page, no explanation); inline-edit drafts across a width change (the provider sits above the swapped page).
